# Honoring Service, Supporting Our Community


3 minutes read


**Posted:** November 2, 2026


## WaterStone Bank Foundation Awards $7,500 to Local Veterans Organizations


Building trust in a community takes time. The WaterStone Bank Foundation has worked to earn that trust through ongoing support of veterans’ causes and by listening to community leaders, customers, and employees who have helped us better understand the challenges that veterans and military service members face.


During Veterans Month, we’re proud to continue putting that commitment into action by awarding $2,500 grants to three area organizations dedicated to supporting veterans.


## [BRAVE Program](https://www.mcw.edu/departments/wisconsin-institute-of-neuroscience-wins/brave-program)


### Medical College of Wisconsin


The BRAVE Program is the first initiative of its kind in the Midwest, providing specialized care and advancing research for veterans and first responders experiencing trauma and related challenges. Foundation funding will help support the program’s mission of delivering innovative treatment and expanding access to care for those living with the invisible wounds of service.


## [Veterans Community Project Milwaukee](https://vcp.org/about-vcp/our-locations/milwaukee/)


Veterans Community Project is developing a Milwaukee tiny-home community designed specifically for veterans experiencing homelessness. The organization provides stable housing and wraparound support services that help veterans rebuild their lives. Foundation support will help advance these efforts and strengthen services for veterans in need.


## [Wisconsin Homeless Veterans Initiative](https://www.wisconsinvets.org/)


For nearly two decades, Wisconsin Homeless Veterans Initiative has helped homeless and at-risk veterans achieve long-term stability through housing assistance, case management, benefits support, and other critical services. Foundation funding will support programs that help veterans secure housing and successfully transition to self-sufficiency.


Through these grants, the WaterStone Bank Foundation is investing in organizations that make a positive difference in the lives of veterans every day, reinforcing our ongoing commitment to those who have served our country.


These grants are just one part of our ongoing support that continues throughout the year. From[career opportunities](https://www.wsbonline.com/careers/) for veterans, developing[banking solutions with military families in mind](https://www.wsbonline.com/personal/checking/mvp-checking/) , to partnering with organizations like the[Association of Military Banks of America](https://www.militarybanking.org/) and the[Veterans Benefits Banking Program](https://veteransbenefitsbanking.org/) , we are committed to better serve those who have served.
